title: NANPA authority for shard-A NPAs 657, 660, 669 and 678

data.notes: Current NANPA material identifies 657 (California 714/657 overlay), 660 (Missouri), 669 (California 408/669 overlay) and 678 (Georgia 404/470/678/770/943 overlay complex) as U.S. geographic NPAs. Each satisfies shard-A rule integer(NPA) mod 3 == 0.

title: Orange County ABCF current federation directory

data.notes: Current ABCF contact directory lists Orange County ABCF with a Santa Ana, California public mailing address and public contact email, establishing continued federation-listed organizational presence in the 657/714 locality.

title: Collective Aid OC current public hub

data.notes: Current public Linktree self-describes Collective Aid OC as a 100% mutual-aid fridge/pantry for Orange County, links its Instagram, mission/value statement, community-fridge map, donation channels, and volunteer sheets for Santa Ana and Anaheim.

title: Warrensburg Food Not Bombs historical lead with current-status check

data.notes: A 2017 Warrensburg article reported a newly formed Food Not Bombs chapter. Current 2025-2026 searches across Warrensburg, Sedalia, Kirksville and the broader 660 region did not surface sufficient current first-party or recurring public activity to call the chapter active; retained only as a historical unresolved lead.

title: Apóyate South Bay current 669 locality evidence

data.notes: Current first-party site describes Apóyate SB as a bilingual people-powered mutual-aid network for Santa Clara County and publishes a San Jose address plus public phone +1 (669) 629-0063 and contact email, directly corroborating the 669 locality/communications surface.

title: Food Not Bombs Atlanta current first-party site

data.notes: Current first-party site states Atlanta Food Not Bombs distributes hot meals and groceries, opposes oppression of homeless and poor people, and works to create alternatives to war, capitalism and domination; its volunteer page describes recurring public food preparation and distribution activity.

title: Metro Atlanta Mutual Aid Fund current first-party site

data.notes: Current first-party site describes MAMA Fund as a Metro Atlanta mutual-aid network and fund supporting marginalized communities, operating a timebank and public funding/request surfaces, and publishing a public organizational contact email.
